name: Suki AI vs Freed
title: Suki AI vs Freed: AI Medical Scribe Comparison for Clinicians
description: Compare Suki AI and Freed - two leading AI medical scribes for healthcare documentation. See differences in specialty support, pricing, EHR integration, and accuracy.

summary.bottom_line: Both Suki AI and Freed use AI to automate clinical documentation, saving clinicians hours per day. Suki is more enterprise-focused with deep EHR integrations and multi-specialty support. Freed is known for its simplicity and strong mental health focus. Choose based on your practice size, EHR, and specialty.

sections.heading: Suki AI vs Freed: Overview
sections.content: Both Suki AI and Freed are AI-powered documentation assistants that listen to patient encounters and generate clinical notes. Suki is a more mature, enterprise-focused platform with extensive EHR integrations designed for health systems. Freed is newer and optimized for independent practices, particularly in mental health, with a focus on simplicity and quick setup.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Suki AI uses enterprise pricing that requires contacting sales, making it better suited for larger organizations with implementation budgets. Freed offers transparent per-provider pricing that's accessible for solo practitioners and small groups. This pricing difference reflects their target markets.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: Suki AI offers voice commands beyond documentation (checking schedules, labs, referrals) and integrates deeply with enterprise EHRs. Freed focuses specifically on ambient documentation with strong mental health note templates. If you need broad medical specialty support or have an enterprise EHR, Suki has the edge. For mental health practices with standalone EHRs like SimplePractice, Freed may be the better fit.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Choose based on your practice context:

recommendations.when: You're part of a health system, need deep EHR integration with Epic/Cerner, or work across multiple medical specialties
You're an independent mental health practice, want quick self-service setup, or use SimplePractice/TherapyNotes

faqs.q: Which AI scribe is better for mental health?
faqs.a: Freed is specifically optimized for mental health with note templates designed for therapy sessions. Suki AI supports mental health but is more general-purpose.

faqs.q: Does Suki AI work with SimplePractice?
faqs.a: Suki AI's integrations are primarily with enterprise EHRs. For SimplePractice integration, Freed or the SimplePractice Note Taker add-on are better options.
Both platforms report high accuracy rates, but all AI scribes require clinician review. Accuracy depends on audio quality, accent, and specialty terminology.
